purpose: Every significant engineering claim about SOKONI, with the evidence behind it. State is DERIVED from sources by scripts/evidence-ledger.js — never declared here. A claim cannot promote itself.

stateRules.ASSUMED: no source of any kind. A belief.
stateRules.OBSERVED: one source. Usually the repository. Enough to act on, not enough to certify.
stateRules.VERIFIED: at least one EXECUTED source — a test run or a runtime observation. Reading code is not verification.
stateRules.CERTIFIED: two or more INDEPENDENT source types agree. Repository plus a passing test is not independence if the test only reads the same file.
stateRules.REJECTED: a contradicting source outweighs the supporting ones.
